title: Administration.
bodyText: This chapter shall be administered by the director of commerce and consumer affairs.
bodyHtml: §484-2  Administration.  This chapter shall be administered by the director of commerce and consumer affairs. [L 1967, c 223, §2; HRS §484-2; am L 1982, c 204, §8; am L 1983, c 124, §17; am L 2008, c 19, §50]
